name: BMIT Handaq Data Centre
notes: Handaq data centre at 54/55 Triq Manuel Borg Gauci, Qormi (Tal-Handaq); BMIT Technologies plc completed acquisition of the ~300-rack facility in Jan 2020 (stock-exchange announcement reposted by Rizzo Farrugia); DataCenterMap lists ~1.2 MW (directory figure, unverified); capacity_mw left null per MT methodology (no reliable public MW).

name: Melita Mriehel Secondary Data Centre
notes: Official Melita page: secondary data centre inside Melita's Head Office at Gasan Centre, Triq il-Merghat, Mriehel (Central Business Hub), built to same spec as Madliena primary, PCI-DSS compliant and ISO 27001 certified; Mriehel sits on the Qormi/Birkirkara boundary - official address cites Birkirkara while DataCenterMap assigns it to Qormi; no public MW figure.

name: MITA Gozo Data Centre (Victoria)
notes: Official MITA procurement WAN-connectivity appendix lists 'Gozo Data Centre, St. Francis Square, Victoria, Gozo' as a government site - public-sector facility lead assigned to Rabat Gozo (Victoria = Rabat, Gozo per MT methodology); operational status per procurement reference; no public MW figure.
